findings.description: committedFixRound ignores a steer after the round's session_done, so a steered session gets 'fix committed Nm ago, awaiting re-gate / pup merge <id> --pr' while its worker is still working, even with the conductor running.
The new `MERGE_KINDS` array is a module-level const used once, in `needOf`, for a membership check that the diff turns from two `===` terms into three.

`dashboardSession` takes a `fixRoundOf` callback that exists only to bind row, repoPath and now; passing repoPath and now as plain params and calling committedFixRound directly removes the callback type and lambda.
The comment "A refused gate's line comes first, and the inbox sorts on this alone" has no clear referent for "this", so the reason for the `!gateRefused` guard must be reconstructed from needOf.
